phases.name: plan
phases.description: Emit the implementation plan for the requested change

phases.name: build
phases.description: Apply the planned change and prove it with the gated test command
testCommand: f="$TMPDIR/qds-resident-fixture-count"; n=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); n=$((n+1)); printf '%s' "$n" > "$f"; echo "test attempt $n"; test "$n" -ge 2
